ld.description: #1 Most Studied Strain^ Non GMO Project Verified 50 Billion CFU Probiotic Supplement Free of Gluten, Dairy, Soy 30 Years Experience Good For Your Gut! Our Ultimate Flora™ Extra Care probiotics provide powerful digestive support to maintain your body's good, natural flora. Probiotic Pioneers for 30 Years We have pioneered superior- quality digestive care supplements based on our 30 years of experience, helping people achieve optimal health from the inside out. Extra Care Probiotic for Digestive Discomfort Ultimate Flora™ Extra Care is specifically designed to reestablish digestive balance for those who experience occasional discomfort. The Ultimate Flora Probiotic Difference Delayed Release Capsule Targeted delivery. Stomach acid can destroy probiotics. Ultimate Flora™ delayed release capsules ensure more friendly probiotics reach your intestinal tract. No Delayed Release Capsule does not resist stomach acid. Ultimate Flora™ Delayed Release Capsule is designed to resist stomach acid. Microbiome Optimal Balance Bifidobacteria, naturally found in milk, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi and other fermented foods, declines as we age. Ultimate Flora™ is specially formulated to be high in Bifidobacteria to support a balanced microbiome. Multi Strain Benefits Ultimate Flora™ contains 12 different strains of beneficial probiotics (Bifidobacteria, Lactobacilli, and Lactococci). Some other brands contain only Bifido or only Lacto. Since you have many different strains of probiotics in your intestinal tract, more strains (B's and L's) may be better. Quality purity and potency guaranteed through expiration.¹ ^Based on the number of scientific and clinical studies of Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG for a range of benefits as of January 2022. ¹At Expiration Date under recommended storage conditions. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigeration not required.
